title: A deactivated technician keeps the toggle and gets it back on reactivation
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • Have Work Orders open on Board View for the test location in a second browser tab.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Click Deactivate Account for staff member A.
  2. Switch to the Board View tab.
  3. Reload the Board View page.
  4. Switch to the Settings, Staff tab.
  5. Click Reactivate for staff member A on the Deactivated tab.
  6. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  7. Switch to the Board View tab.
  8. Reload the Board View page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Staff member A moves to the Deactivated tab.
  • Their row there shows "No" in the Technician column.

Step 2:

  • The board tab shows Board View.

Step 3:

  • Board View shows no column for staff member A.
  • Board View shows a column for staff member B.

Step 4:

  • The staff list shows.

Step 5:

  • Staff member A moves back to the Active tab.
  • Their row shows "Yes" in the Technician column.

Step 6:

  • Time Clock is on and Technician is on, as before the deactivation.

Step 7:

  • The board tab shows Board View.

Step 8:

  • After the reload Board View shows a column for staff member A again.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member), story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists), story SV-11882 (Story 4, Technician column and notice on the staff list)

  • S1-E2: “A deactivated staff member keeps their Technician toggle as it was, but is not a technician while deactivated (Story 3). Reactivating them brings it back as it was.”
  • S4-R1: “The staff list (Settings, Staff) gains a read-only "Technician" column directly left of Billable, on the Active and Deactivated tabs. Each row shows "Yes" (green) when the person is active, their Technician toggle is on and their Time Clock is on, otherwise "No" (red), in the same style as the Billable column. A deactivated person always shows "No", whatever their toggles.”
  • S3-R1: “A person is offered on a technician list at a location when all of these hold: their Technician toggle is on, their Time Clock is on, their user is active, they are enrolled at that location, and their role is not the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
